reviews.text: I have been a loyal client since my dog was a puppy, and I am very pleased with my decision; the entire team provides exceptional service.
Annual check up and vaccinations

I walked in first thing in the morning, everyone was friendly. We didn't wait very long. They got right to the point and didn't try and gouge us for unnecessary shots. Had it been just a little cheaper, I might fire my doctor and get my issues taken care of there

Great place, good service, however be aware. We brought or dog in for a rabies shot, they booked us in for next year and I asked them to make sure we were within the 1 year windows so the vaccine would go for two years after, well they booked us in For 1 year a day after the first vaccine.  Now we have to get our dog another vaccine next year. Feels like we got set up for additional visit. This is not cool. I like this clinic and would've liked to continue to use them, but after this I will not use them again. It is a bummer because the staff is great and the doctors are really good but I really feel like they set this up and I am not happy about it.

This was my first visit to North Channel, unfortunately it was an emergency visit with my fur baby.  My normal vet was closed the day of the accident and we showed up one hour before closing. They went above and beyond to make sure my pet was seen in a timely manner, even though he wasn't on their schedule. They made sure my pet had what he needed, was diagnosed, and treated for pain from his injury. They also called to check on his well being the next day. I will definitely, going forward in the future be recommending North Channel to pet parents! Thanks and much appreciation to the staff for the kindness and care given to my pet and our family!

They staff is amazing. I have been taking my Shepherd/Malinois to them since May of this year. She is very big dog and very scared of people snd other dogs. But she does very well well with the staff and Drs. They are so patient with her and basically let her take her time to adjust. I appreciate them all very much. They are wonderful.

I have had dogs my entire life and this place was the first that made me feel comfortable.  They also made my Journee Jo comfortable.  They didn't expect me to pick up my 66lbs Boxer-mix and put her on the table.  They got down on the floor and talked and pet her.  They never asked or demanded a muzzle.  Instead of getting a stool sample from her butt, thay asked if she pooped outside and went out there to scoop the sample from that.  It was an AMAZING experience.  This is her forever doctor.❤️🐕
Dr Watts and the rest of the staff were incredible! We’re switching all of our animals here from now on!
Thank you for your review and the 5-star rating. We appreciate your trust in our team at North Channel Animal Hospital.
Thank you immensely for your positive feedback. We're grateful for the 5 stars.

I took Amari, my last remaining pupper, in for her yearly and because she started limping. My niece had a very positive experience with their rescue so I took mine. I made a same day appointment online. How often does that happen? Check in was easy, and there was a small wait to be called back. The vet tech asked really good questions, and...LISTENED to the answers! The most telling aspect of the visit was that Amari readily went with her without pulling. The vet herself was great. She got down to Amari's level, and explained that's since Amari's a senior now😳 there were some additional care items to consider. Check out was very easy. It seemed a little expensive, but the excellent service and year long HW prevention shot were well worth the cost! Amari and I highly recommend!
Freindly atmosphere.Always ready to help.
